pages.title: Chelation Column
pages.text: A column of grabbing molecules: metal ions caught as the water runs through, the most tightly held first.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Set the flow and the EDTA dose. Removal follows the binding constant; too much flow for the dose saturates the column. 95% must come out.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 1 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Molten Salt Fuel, Rare Earth Oxide, Water.
